hook: Youth Congress protest inside Meta's Raidurgam office; *21* taken into custody
hook_b: Youth Congress protest inside Meta's Raidurgam office; *21* taken into custody
tldr: Telangana Youth Congress members protested at Meta's office in Raidurgam on Friday over blocked accounts of two national Youth Congress leaders; police said state president Jakkidi Shiva Charan Reddy and 20 others were taken into preventive custody.

beats.what: Police said around 25 activists entered the access-controlled Sky View premises around 3 pm, raised slogans and staged a sit-in; TOI reports flower pots in a corridor were damaged.
beats.why: Protesters said Meta blocked the social media accounts of Youth Congress leaders Uday Bhanu and Manish Sharma and demanded they be restored.
beats.care: Sky View in Raidurgam is an access-controlled office complex in the IT corridor.

cards.q: Should platforms explain publicly when they block political accounts?

qs: What should a platform disclose when it blocks a politician's account?

facts.t: Police said about *25* activists entered the access-controlled Sky View premises around 3 pm.

viz.verdict: Protest to bail within a day

watch: Whether Meta restores the blocked accounts or responds publicly.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Meta blocks Youth Congress leaders' accounts: Workers storm Hyderabad office, damage flower pots; 21 detained

fact: Youth Congress protest at Meta's Raidurgam office ends with *21* in custody
twist: All 21 were released on bail the same day after giving sureties.
